learning_outcomes.text: The student is capable of drawing machine parts with current technical drawing norms.

The student is capable of reading information of machine elements on assembly drawings.
The student understands spatial construction of mechanical assemblies.
The student reads diagrams of the technical systems.

syllabus_topics: Normalized parts on drawing (bearings, gears, clutch, axes)
assessment_rules: To pass the subject, a minimum of 60% is required for both design classes and the final colloquium. The final grade is calculated as 40% from design classes and 60% from the final colloquium.
